before_publish._comment: What the Draft builds lack. Each is a hand step in the GHL builder before that workflow goes live. Checked 2026-11-07.
before_publish.postal_address: Custom value postal_address does not exist yet, so every footer renders blank. Create it with the real address from go-live step 6.
before_publish.sender: Every email action leaves From blank, so GHL uses the location's default sender. Not checked. If it names the legal entity, set a Find Me Money Group From in each workflow's Settings > Sender details.
before_publish.unsubscribe: Confirm GHL adds its unsubscribe link to these emails. If it doesn't, add one to the footer.
before_publish.exit_tags: Not built. Add a step or goal that ends the workflow on each flow's exit_tags.
before_publish.never_enroll_tags: Not built. The trigger only checks the tag that starts the flow. Add an If/Else on never_enroll_tags as the first step.
before_publish.reactivation_also_when: Not built. Reactivation starts on seq:check-back only. The 30-days-quiet start on Lead Radar Leads needs its own trigger or the agent setting seq:check-back.
before_publish.first_name: {{contact.first_name}} has no fallback, so a contact with no first name gets 'Hi ,'. Set a default such as 'there'.
before_publish.re_entry: Allow re-entry is on (GHL's default). Re-adding a seq tag restarts the series. Turn it off if a series should run once per person.
before_publish.done: Stop on response is on for Nurture, Reactivation and Sales Content. All four are Draft.
